name: Monday.com Lead Intake with Dedupe, Round Robin and SLA Nudges

parameters.content:
## 1. Security
The form sends the shared secret in the X-Webhook-Secret header (or as ?key= in the URL if it cannot set headers). Anything else gets a 401 and raises an alert.

## 2. Clean and dedupe
Email in lowercase, phone in E.164. Bad posts get a 422. A repeat delivery of the same submission gets a 200 and is skipped.

## 3. Find or create in Monday
Searches the board by email and by phone. A known lead gets an update with the new inquiry and a field refresh. A new lead is created with status New and the next owner in the rotation. If Monday refuses only the phone number or email, the lead is saved without it. If Monday fails, the form gets a 503 so it can retry, and you get an alert with the lead.

## 4. Tell the owner
The form gets its answer first. Then the delivery is remembered and the owner gets a Slack message with a link to the item.

## 5. SLA check
Runs every 30 minutes. Run Now does the same on demand and needs the X-Run-Secret header.

## 6. Find overdue leads
Reads every item still in status New, page by page, and decides who needs a reminder.

## 7. Nudge and escalate
One Slack message per person, sent one at a time so a retry never repeats a message that already went out. Only accepted messages are remembered.

parameters.errorMessage: Lead webhook rejected: the X-Webhook-Secret header (or ?key= in the URL) is missing or wrong. If real form posts land here, check LEAD_WEBHOOK_SECRET and what your form sends.

={{ 'The lead is saved in Monday (item ' + $('Build Owner Alert').first().json.itemId + ') but Slack refused the owner alert: ' + ($json.error?.message || 'Unknown error') + '. Check SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL and the slackWebhookUrl values in OWNERS_JSON. The SLA check will still nudge the owner.' }}
Run Now rejected: the X-Run-Secret header is missing or wrong. Check RUN_NOW_SECRET.
={{ 'The SLA check could not read the board: ' + ($json.error?.message || 'Unknown error') + '. No reminders were sent; the next run tries again.' }}
={{ 'Slack refused ' + $input.all().length + ' SLA alert(s). They are sent again on the next run. ' + $input.all().map(i => i.json.error?.message || 'Unknown error').join(' | ') }}
